settings.heading: The Dandy FAQ.
settings.lede: The questions people actually ask, answered without the marketing voice.

settings.heading: Before you buy
settings.a1: It's legal in 34 states. We don't ship to the other 16 — the list is on our shipping page, and checkout blocks those addresses.
settings.a2: Effects vary by person, food, and amount. That's why every gummy is exactly 35 mg and why we say start with one and wait.
settings.q3: Will I fail a drug test?
settings.a3: Kratom's alkaloids aren't screened on standard panels, but specialized tests exist. If testing matters in your life, we can't promise a result — nobody honestly can.
settings.a4: Every batch is screened by an independent lab for identity, mitragynine potency, heavy metals, and microbials. The batch number is on your pouch.
settings.a5: Anyone under 21, anyone pregnant or nursing, and anyone on medication without talking to their clinician first.
settings.a6: Regular daily use can build tolerance and habit. That's real, it's on our label, and it's why the guidance says start low and take breaks.
